schema_probe.probe_scope: sheet names, dimensions, and first non-empty row/header only

binding.subject: participantid
binding.source_unit: copies/mL as indicated by workbook/header and associated dataset
binding.coordinate_transform: x=log10(nasal_load), y=log10(saliva_load) for strictly positive finite numeric values

deterministic_rules.eligible_visit: subject and time finite/present; saliva_load and nasal_load parse as finite numeric values strictly greater than zero
deterministic_rules.non_numeric_or_nonpositive_load: missing/non-quantifiable for C034; do not impute a detection-limit value
deterministic_rules.duplicate_subject_time: if more than one eligible raw row shares the same subject and exact numeric time, mark that time ambiguous and exclude all rows at that key
deterministic_rules.signed_area: close chronological polyline from last point to first and apply the frozen shoelace formula
